persistence.finding: Rust passes and journals the complete game Value; trust arithmetic belongs to the authored JavaScript. Exact serialized input also forms the host view-cache key.

preservationContract: Every earlier explicit trust value must resolve to the same integer after upgrade. Historical engines 2 through 20 and their pre-upgrade journal behavior stay exact. A future explicit migration would compare expanded peer-by-peer values, including every earlier zero, as well as real decisions, learning observations and replay.
